name: tien-os-marketplace

plugins.name: unknown-remover
plugins.description: [tien-os] Classify the unknown, choose the artifact form, and write one chain document at a time.

plugins.name: eval-writer
plugins.description: [tien-os] Defines measurable success criteria and designs evaluations for any LLM-based task, product, feature, or piece of logic.

plugins.name: agent-builder
plugins.description: [tien-os] Create, evaluate, and package independent one-agent-with-licensed-skills plugins.

plugins.name: behavior-implementer
plugins.description: [tien-os] Implements features scenario-first: Given/When/Then scenarios seen failing, the three laws of TDD, and a measured quality gate before every commit.

description: Four agent plugins for Claude Code and Codex: unknown-remover (planning by unknown-removal), eval-writer (success criteria and evaluations), agent-builder (creates, evaluates, and packages capabilities), and behavior-implementer (scenario-first BDD/TDD implementation).
